summary_en: This study is testing ECI830 alone and in combination with ribociclib and fulvestrant in patients with advanced HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer, advanced CCNE1-amplified solid tumors, and extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. The record does not state how ECI830 is given, how often, or for how long. The main goals are safety and tolerability with a dose range in Phase I, and anti-tumor activity in Phase II (Phase 1/2 study).
summary_es: Este estudio prueba ECI830 solo y en combinación con ribociclib y fulvestrant en pacientes con cáncer de mama avanzado HR positivo y HER2 negativo, tumores sólidos avanzados con amplificación de CCNE1 y cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en etapa extensa. El registro no indica cómo se administra ECI830, con qué frecuencia ni por cuánto tiempo. Los objetivos principales son la seguridad y tolerabilidad, con un rango de dosis en la Fase I, y la actividad antitumoral en la Fase II (estudio de Fase 1/2).
who_for: HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer that progressed on hormone therapy with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (Phase I), or on an aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen with a
Advanced solid tumor with a CCNE1 amplification, confirmed by biopsy or cytology (Phase I).
Extensive-stage small cell lung cancer that progressed on or after standard treatment (Phase I).
Measurable disease by RECIST v1.1 (Phase II); some breast cancer patients without measurable disease need a predominantly lytic bone lesion.
not_for: Previous treatment with a CDK2 inhibitor at any time.
Inadequate bone marrow or organ function based on out-of-range lab values.
Clinically significant uncontrolled heart disease or heart rhythm (repolarization) abnormality, including long QT syndrome.
Symptomatic brain metastases, or brain metastases needing local therapy or rising steroid doses within 2 weeks before entry.
Women who are pregnant or nursing, or who could become pregnant and will not use highly effective contraception; also patients using hormone replacement therapy
